title: The Melted Ice
scene: At 8:50 PM, the rink ice swan melted. The Zamboni was out of service and the doors locked from 8:30 to 9:10.

suspects.name: Ivan Vale
suspects.testimony: I was in the stands at 8:50, watching the skate.
suspects.contradiction: The stands camera shows no one at 8:50, and meltwater soaked Ivan's gloves.

suspects.name: Julia Nath
suspects.testimony: I was on the ice at 8:50 during the routine.
suspects.alibiProof: The rink camera shows Julia in the center at 8:49 and 8:52.

suspects.name: Kyle Reed
suspects.testimony: I was at the penalty box at 8:50.
suspects.alibiProof: The game log shows Kyle's whistle at 8:48 and 8:51.

suspects.name: Lena Pike
suspects.testimony: I was selling cocoa at the concession at 8:50.
suspects.alibiProof: The concession camera shows Lena at 8:47 and 8:54.
